concerns.text: T027 (Monte Carlo generation) is marked [P] (parallel-safe) but depends on T027b (benchmarking/batching logic) which must 'validate throughput and define the batching strategy BEFORE full run'. T027b is listed after T027 in the task list, creating a logical dependency violation where the consumer (T027) precedes its producer (T027b). T027b must precede T027.

T005 (Checksum verification logic) writes to `state/projects/...yaml`. T001a creates the `state/` directory, but T005 is marked [P] alongside T001a. If T005 runs before T001a completes, the target file path does not exist. T005 must strictly follow T001a (or T001a must be unmarked [P] and ordered first).

T020 (Exposure correction) explicitly states 'depends on T013 output' (HEALPix map). However, T020 is marked [P] (parallel-safe) in the task list. T020 cannot be parallel-safe if it consumes an artifact produced by T013. T020 must be unmarked [P] and ordered after T013.

T028 (Significance test) depends on T027/T027b completion (null distribution generation). T028 is marked [P]. It cannot run in parallel with T027/T027b. T028 must be unmarked [P] and ordered after T027/T027b.

T032 and T033 update `research.md`. T032a/T034a create placeholders for `research.md` and `data-model.md`. T032/T033 are marked [P] but logically depend on the existence of the files created in T032a/T034a. While file creation is fast, strict ordering requires T032a/T034a to precede T032/T033 to ensure the target files exist before writing.
